items.title: 'I wouldn't be here today without you': Student's praise for man who stopped train attacker
items.summary: Astrid credits Stephen Crean with saving her life during the Huntingdon train attack last year.

items.title: Kenyan cult leader in jail for 191 murders convicted over another 123 deaths
items.summary: A Kenyan cult leader has been convicted of manslaughter over the deaths of 123 of his followers, having already been found guilty of murdering 191 others.

items.title: NHS boss warns of 'horrible spike' in flu as hospital admissions surge
items.summary: Health officials are urging those at risk of getting flu to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

items.title: Poundland boss urges staff to feel pride in turnaround efforts
items.summary: Poundland's boss has told staff to feel proud of their efforts to revitalise the discount retailer despite its collapse into administration earlier this week.

items.title: 'We have no interest in hearing from Huw Edwards', Downing Street says
items.summary: There has been a backlash against new interviews with the disgraced former BBC News presenter.

items.title: Powerful storm knocks out power and disrupts flights in US - as major Thanksgiving event cancelled
items.summary: Powerful storms across the US have left hundreds of thousands of homes without power and disrupted thousands of flights ahead of Thanksgiving weekend.
